LESSON: PERSONAL HYGIENE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin
Topic 3.1: Personal Hygiene
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Personal Hygiene, part of HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How does personal hygiene promote good health?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign terms related to personal hygiene in daily life.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Personal Hygiene in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify healthy practices that promote personal hygiene,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Personal Hygiene in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. apply healthy practices that promote personal hygiene,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Personal Hygiene in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. embrace healthy practices to promote personal hygiene in daily life. • in purposive groups, learners are guided to watch captioned video clips or demonstrations on how to sign terms related to personal hygiene in daily life, • in pairs, the learners are guided to fingerspell and sign terms related to personal hygiene in daily life. • in purposive groups, learners are guided to brainstorm and enumerate practices that promote personal hygiene such as hand washing, use of personal protective equipment and use of clean water, • in purposive groups, learners are guided to watch captioned videos or one on one demonstration on appropriate practices that promote personal hygiene in daily life. • in purposive groups, learners are guided to perform appropriate practices that promote personal How does personal hygiene promote good health? 31 hygiene such as hand washing, use of personal protective equipment and use of clean water, • learners are guided to keep a diary log of various health hygiene practices for a specified period of time to embrace personal health promotion.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Personal Hygiene in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Personal Hygiene together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: taking charge of their own body as they practise personal hygiene and use personal protective equipment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Prevention of communicable diseases as learners practise personal hygiene.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate personal hygiene practices to prevention of communicable diseases learnt in Science and Technology.
